tagline: Create beautiful slide decks using Markdown

evaluation.by: a Marp render and a slide lint

examples.prompt: Make a ten-minute keynote for a science festival about the deep ocean: how deep it goes, how little of the seafloor we have mapped, and the global push to finish the map by 2030.
examples.caption: Deep-sea keynote · 9 slides, ocean art, seafloor chart, speaker notes

examples.prompt: Make a keynote for the internal launch of Harness, a Mac app that runs coding agents in persistent terminals you can reach from any device, with a live viewer for the work they produce. Audience: 200 engineers at an all-hands. 10 minutes. Include a chart with our growth: 12 teams in 2023, 31 in 2024, 64 in 2025, 140 today.
examples.caption: Launch keynote · 10 slides, generated art, growth chart, speaker notes
